title: 6-Month Transportation Design Internship (Hamburg)
note: One transportation design spot per semester; only for students who need a compulsory internship.

facts.summary: One six-month transportation design internship per semester at TEAMS Hamburg, starting March 2027.
facts.duties: Help with research, concepts, ergonomics and design development on product and mobility projects.
facts.requirements: Enrolled industrial/product/transportation design student needing a required internship; Rhino or SolidWorks, KeyShot, Photoshop; strong sketching and English.
facts.apply: Email cover letter, CV and process portfolio (PDF, 10-15MB max), or use the form on the page.
